clips.title: The story
paras: Trade and piracy shape the Merchant Coast along the Barrens' eastern shore. Ratchet handles sea trade, while pirates contest the coast.

The Merchant Coast runs along the Barrens' eastern edge, where ships link central Kalimdor with the Eastern Kingdoms and Theramore. The Steamwheedle Cartel's neutral port of Ratchet takes cargo from anyone with coin. Southsea Freebooters also haunt the sands and nearby waters, preying on merchant ships and setting up illicit operations along the beaches.
